decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) an abrupt multi-axis shift near index 490–500 with sustained offset, and (2) a prolonged elevated U platform from ~660 onward with ambiguous partial return around 700–710. Both involve overlapping cross-axis changes without clear full reversals.

regions.observation: N/E/U show a multi-sample shift around index ~490–500: N jumps from ~2–3 to ~6–8, E drops from ~-1 to ~-2.5, U rises from ~-1 to ~0.7; the change is abrupt and sustained, with no clear return in this window.

From ~660 onward, U shows a sustained platform near 3–5, while N and E fluctuate but remain broadly elevated (N ~4–6, E ~-2 to -3); a possible opposing return or superposed offset appears around index 700–710 where U dips briefly before rebounding, suggesting ambiguous recovery or secondary change.
